tips.text: Take the Neuroptics from Circuit week 9 at tier 2 instead of grinding Terrorem; it needs only four stages.
Never leave with a public squad before 20:00; the run never reaches a Rotation C roll.
Bring Heat or Slash damage and melee; Terrorem is Infested with no armor.
Bring a health-tank or invisibility frame; Toxic Ancients chew through shield-only builds during the 20-minute hold.
Claim the low Circuit tiers on Octavia's week and split the rest across days; four stages a day earn a progress bonus.
Hunt the music room in Copernicus Capture; its short, wide tiles let you check a map in under a minute and reload.
Use the room with glowing blue pressure plates around a central pillar, not the Agility Test's giant organ; leave and reload if you enter the wrong one.
Bring Titania, Wukong or Zephyr to check rooms and reach the upper crate faster.
Bring a loot radar to Plato; caches show on the minimap and hum, so listen for them as a backup.
Use mixed damage or Operator Void Beam on Plato's Sentients to reset their damage adaptation.
Farm the Plato Systems in the same Lua session as the music-room Capture reloads.
Start all three component builds in parallel before starting Octavia's final build.
Farm Kuva and Orokin Cells before the components finish so Systems is not the last delay.
Expect about four Rotation C pulls for the Neuroptics; some players report ten to sixteen straight runs with nothing.
Players regret grinding Terrorem to the end instead of waiting for Octavia's Circuit week.
